description.value: Spinnakers Gastro Brewpub is Canada's first purpose-built gastro brewpub, crafting beer on Victoria's Inner Harbour since 1984 and helping define BC's craft brewing culture. The waterfront complex features a covered heated patio, a taproom pouring an extensive range of house-brewed ales, ciders, and spirits, a full farm-to-table restaurant, and heritage guesthouse accommodations. With partnerships across more than 35 local farmers and producers, it delivers a distinctly Vancouver Island experience in the heart of Vic West.
